description: This file appears to be a PHP script responsible for rendering and managing the second step of a Home Network Wizard interface for a web-based device configuration portal. It includes HTML, PHP, and JavaScript code to display configuration options for Wi-Fi networks, handle form validation, and interact with backend services to save settings.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the configuration data to a backend handler via POST request to save Wi-Fi network settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration object, and calls set_config to save the Wi-Fi settings.

methods.name: addslashes
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string to safely include it in JSON or other data formats.
